Pass by value and object identity

JavaScript passes values by value. For objects, the copied value refers to the same object, so
property mutation can be visible to the caller.

Interview question: Is JavaScript pass by reference?
Answer: No. Arguments are passed by value; object references are values too.
Remember: Shared object, copied reference value.
